steps.title: Define application architecture and directory outline
steps.description: Establish the project structure, resource directories, package boundaries, and local SQLite data models for Study Planner.

steps.title: Configure Gradle project build specifications
steps.description: Establish proper compilation limits, SDK targets (34), and dependency definitions strictly using Android SDK native classes.

steps.title: Establish application Manifest and permission controls
steps.description: Declare permissions for alarm scheduling, boot receiver, runtime notifications, and launch activities.

steps.title: Define UI theme constants and localization strings
steps.description: Set color palettes (Indigo primaries, pastel alerts) and strings resources used throughout active modules.

steps.title: Develop dynamic styling resource backgrounds
steps.description: Generate modern XML drawables for card layouts, state indicators, interactive custom buttons, and action panels.

steps.title: Design user interactive dialog dialogs interfaces
steps.description: Develop functional dialog views allowing creation and updating of Subject entities, Task requirements, and custom notification Reminders.

steps.title: Create primary view panel screen structure
steps.description: Formulate main layout with tab control elements and four sub-views: Dashboard view, Subject manager, Task compiler, and Reminder planner.

steps.title: Build local persistence Database framework
steps.description: Program StudyDatabaseHelper using built-in Android SQLite SDK to reliably execute relational schemas for academic tracker metrics.

steps.title: Implement background Reminder alarms receiver listener
steps.description: Set up BroadcastReceiver executing system alert notifications on custom channel trigger times.

steps.title: Build dynamic user views populator core logic
steps.description: Construct dynamic Java 8 layout constructors creating visual metrics, checklist behaviors, stats, and dialogs.

steps.title: Building Study Planner
steps.description: Initiate build environment assembly via Android Gradle build manager debug targets.
